reason: The cited evidence does not address precipitation in TiVNbTa; E1 and E2 discuss a different alloy (TiVNb) with no precipitates, E3 concerns a dual-phase W-containing alloy, and E4 mentions Laves phase strengthening in other HEAs but not in TiVNbTa. No evidence supports the key premises that TiVNbTa can form stable nanoprecipitates or that such precipitates would improve high-temperature strength.
premises: Nanometric precipitates can form in BCC refractory HEAs via heat treatment
Such precipitates act as dislocation pinning centers at high temperature
Precipitation strengthening can mitigate high-temperature strength loss in refractory HEAs
The TiVNbTa alloy system is amenable to precipitation of stable secondary phases
